game_concept: A action puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Smoke Ridge, a ridge shrouded in ash: the ember mage must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Arithmetic Cannon: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on smoke serpents.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Smoke Ridge: a ridge shrouded in ash
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Read value for station 7, then display the same value without changing it. Test dataset 7: {'value': -7}; {'value': 21}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Arithmetic Cannon' (Week 2 slot 2), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Smoke Ridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Collect 140 points of fire gems by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
source_lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 140, or lives reach 0.
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
